measurement_runtime: Playwright browser using direct Figshare API/file streaming; committed script reproduces the same frozen protocol

dataset.title: A ballistocardiogram dataset with reference ECG signals for bed-based heart rhythm assessment

representation.name: frozen_source_band_spectrum_v1
representation.status: fixed source-defined representation; no target labels used to fit representation
representation.source_definition: primary sleep-fingerprint respiratory/cardiac frequency boundaries and phase-insensitive spectrum summaries
representation.features: 22 log band energies + respiratory peak + cardiac peak + respiratory entropy + cardiac entropy + cardiac centroid + log high/fundamental cardiac power ratio
representation.normalization: per-window linear detrend + robust median/MAD; median aggregation across 8 non-overlapping windows

split.method: deterministic seeded subject-only 5-fold assignment; every participant appears in exactly one test fold

probe.model: ridge regression used as linear score probe
probe.target_fit: StandardScaler fit on target training subjects inside each fold, then ridge probe; representation remains frozen

broad_af.definition: persistent atrial fibrillation or paroxysmal atrial flutter in Conclusion, or any non-empty/non-'/' Atrial Fibrillation event field

persistent_af.definition: Conclusion contains exact phrase 'persistent atrial fibrillation'
persistent_af.selection_note: exploratory continuous-rhythm endpoint selected after inspecting available clinical metadata; not confirmatory

subject_bootstrap_95ci.method: 20,000-iteration stratified subject bootstrap over out-of-fold predictions

gate_3_interpretation: met as measurable independent cardiovascular transfer, but evidence is modest/exploratory and does not override setup/time confounds
